prompt: Product render of a single sealed collectible sticker pack (booster pack wrapper) for a kids creature card game, seen perfectly from the front, straight and centered, tall rectangle shape. Crimped serrated heat-sealed strips at the very top and very bottom with fine vertical ridges. Glossy metallic foil plastic with strong light reflections, soft pillow-like puffiness, subtle wrinkles and a faint vertical seam. The foil is holographic rainbow: shifting pink, turquoise, yellow and light orange, very shiny like an iridescent sticker. In the middle of the front there is a large empty starburst panel with nothing inside, and an empty rounded band near the top for a logo. Fun, bright and inviting for kids aged 9 to 11. Absolutely no text, no letters, no numbers, no logo, no characters, no animals, no people. Plain pure white background, soft shadow under the pack. Original design, not based on any existing brand or franchise.
